steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: assert-history-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.history !== false) throw new Error('history flag should be OFF in Simple mode but got: ' + window.__store.getState().featureFlags.history)

steps.name: assert-history-enabled-in-pro
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().featureFlags.history) throw new Error('history flag should be ON in Pro mode')

steps.name: place-item-step1
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id: 'h-sofa-1', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9, 3], rotation: 0, props: {} }])

steps.name: assert-history-has-steps
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().past.length < 2) throw new Error('Expected at least 2 history steps, got ' + window.__store.getState().past.length)

steps.name: assert-jumped-to-first
steps.eval: (() => { const items = window.__store.getState().items; if (items.length !== 1) throw new Error('After jumping to step 0 (first push = sofa only): expected 1 item, got ' + items.length); if (items[0].defId !== 'sofa-3seat') throw new Error('Expected sofa-3seat at step 0, got ' + items[0].defId); })()

steps.name: jump-to-latest
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const totalSteps = st.past.length + 1 + st.future.length; st.jumpHistory(totalSteps - 1); })()

steps.name: assert-history-hidden-again
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.history !== false) throw new Error('history should be OFF again in Simple mode')
